item.title: Abandoned dog rescued from massive snowstorm after 6 days in freezing temps
item.description: On Tuesday, a dog now dubbed Lala, was rescued in Needham, Massachusetts after being exposed to a massive snowstorm and below freezing temperatures for six days. Lala was found in a backyard on Bess Road after having been seen by concerned neighbors in the area several times.
